latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — restore quality from compressed videos automatically via cloud AI.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB to fix blocky or blurry compression artifacts.
- No manual editing required — just describe your goal and the AI handles enhancement.
- Simple setup: connects to cloud backend, sets up authentication, lets you know when ready.
- Supports credits system, timeline preview, and fast 1-2 minute server-side exports.
- Handles all major video formats; provides clear error messages for unsupported files or quota issues.
